sentence: A busy clinic, a full waiting room.
A patient steps out when called, and their name can drop off the list.
With Mega-Net EHR Cloud, a skipped patient stays on the waiting list.
The nurse sees them marked as skipped, with the reason underneath.
They keep their original place in the line.
When they are back, the nurse calls them, and the mark clears.
So a patient who steps out is easy to call again.
